summary: Sasol Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 5, 2026, for the period ending that date. The filing contains no substantive special-situation transaction content; it appears to be a routine foreign private issuer report with only cover-page metadata and graphical image data. There are no disclosed acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, capital returns, or management changes. The submission is classified as a standard periodic report with no discernible event triggering special-situations classification.
